The strongest methodological matches are general mechanistic-interpretability studies, rather than demonstrated HSTU circuits. [Activation-patching guidance (2024)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.15255) emphasizes paired replacement interventions, both restoration and disruption directions, and sensitivity to the chosen metric and corrupted input. [AtP* (2024)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.00745) supports gradient-based screening followed by exact patching; gradient approximations can miss influential components. [HSTU’s original paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.17152) supplies the architectural basis for inspecting spatial aggregation and multiplicative gating, but does not establish their attribution faithfulness.

Proposed adaptation: pair within-category histories with identical final items, lengths and padding masks but different earlier contexts. In evaluation mode, swap earlier-position activations, aggregation outputs, gates and residual updates separately; test position embeddings separately while holding item inputs fixed. Preserve final-nonpadding readout and fixed candidate sets. Measure bidirectional changes in a predeclared candidate-score margin; report raw changes when normalized recovery has a near-zero denominator. Include no-patch, identity-patch and padding-only controls. Compare gradient-dot-activation-difference predictions with exact interventions using sign agreement and rank correlation, auditing some low-attribution components for false negatives. Residual-stream replacement measures cumulative information, so it cannot alone isolate a particular branch.

Predeclare three training hypotheses: earlier-history dropout reduces final-item shortcuts; gate-scale regularization improves historical transmission; weaker positional embeddings reduce position dependence. These are hypotheses to validate, not literature-established improvements. [Saliency sanity checks](https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.03292) additionally motivate checking attribution dependence on learned parameters using a temporary randomized diagnostic copy. Keep one trained HSTU per category, select changes by macro validation HR@10, and describe intervention results as model sensitivity—not causal user preferences.
